messages:
Alex M.: quick heads-up — incoming customer request to evaluate 'galileo-lite-8b' for private deployment. They care about latency under 90ms p95 and embedding parity with ada-002 on our eval suite. Can eng-ml pick this up? @Nina C. @Prateek

Nina C.: adding to queue. what's model format? hf path or tar.gz?

Alex M.: HF tar.gz (transformers + KV cache). vendor says fp16 only, no QAT. Also they flagged poor instruction-following on a few shots — shared examples in the link.

Prateek: i'll triage quant readiness. priority: 1) smoke build, 2) perf bench on T4, 3) quant profile. ETA today for smoke. @QuantBot run quick smoke?

QuantBot: queued smoke job 4041122334-smoke. Running: model load -> simple generation -> perf profile.

DeployBot: FYI, sandbox infra has 2xT4 available in project 'cust-onramp-23'.

Eva L.: I can run the eval suite for instruction-following. share prompt set?

Alex M.: prompt set link: https://redwood-internal/drive/galileo-lite/prompts (internal). Also attached 6 sample failures.

Prateek: results from smoke: load ok, KV cache healthy. perf baseline: p95 token-latency 78ms on a single T4 (seq len typical 256), throughput ~24 tok/s. Memory headroom ~4GB.

Nina C.: nice baseline. next: quant path. i'd like to try an 8-bit PTQ (bitsandbytes) first. vendor didn't ship GPTQ splits.

Prateek: trying PTQ bnb. command i'm using:
```bash
python quantize.py --model ./galileo-lite --backend bitsandbytes --bits 8 --calib 1000
```
observed small logits drift on zero-shot NLI (confident flips on 3/200 examples).

Eva L.: hold — that drift matches the instruction-failure profile we saw. i'll run eval before/after quant to get exact delta.

Alex M.: decision point: expose catalog entry 'galileo-lite.fp16' only, or also publish 'galileo-lite.8bit' with warnings. customer prefers low-cost option if quality acceptable.

Prateek: propose canary plan: enable 8-bit variant behind feature flag + traffic cap 10%. Monitor quality delta on key prompt set; auto-rollback if correctness drops >2% absolute.

Nina C.: adding checklist items here:
- run A/B eval on canonical prompts (pre/post quant)
- gather token-level latency (p50/p95) and throughput
- run safety filters and hallucination checks
- produce model card with quant caveats
- create canary rollout runbook + alert thresholds

Eva L.: i'll own the A/B eval. need canonical prompt set + expected labels. ETA 4h for initial results.

Alex M.: thanks. @DeployBot please create canary route if quant variant passes and create jira ticket for tracking. tag support and customer success.

DeployBot: created JIRA INF-5234 'galileo-lite onramp' and canary route stub 'galileo-lite-canary'.

QuantBot: smoke job finished — logs: s3://redwood-logs/4041122334-smoke. Summary: load ok; generation sanity checks passed; quant attempt flagged minor logits drift (see logs).

Prateek: next steps: run PTQ with 2k calib and run Eva's A/B. posting progress and any blockers here.

Alex M.: :thumbsup: plan sounds good. if quality gap <1% and latency improves ~25%, recommend 8-bit to customer with 'canary-only' rollout first. keep notes in INF-5234.
